method: Two separate CPython processes read only workflow.json, native/trace-report.json and native/correctness/report.json during the profiler workflow. No GPU or OS-process query, source mutation or additional GPU worker.
scope: Transcribed tool observations, not a timestamped profiler export. The first read may overlap a marked generate call; CPU scheduling overhead was not isolated. Preserve as a possible host-side diagnostic confound. Profile durations remain instrumented diagnostics, never clean HTTP timings or causal optimization gains. Immutable raw profiler archive is unchanged.
